settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure NoteFast options. Local-first; database backups, Markdown archive and AI are all optional.

maintenance.autoHint: Run maintenance only physically deletes residue older than 30 days (plus stale history and vector generations); newer residue stays. A pass also runs every 6 hours. Vacuum reclaims deleted pages and truncates the WAL.
maintenance.vacuumMessage: VACUUM physically reclaims space from deleted data and may shrink the database file. On large databases it can stall briefly for a few seconds; keep the app open during the run.

about.blurb: NoteFast is an AI-native Markdown knowledge base that automatically indexes, links, and searches every note.
about.checkFailed: Check failed. Try again later or open
about.manualHint: Update checks only run when you click; the app does not phone home on launch.

imageUpload.description: Images are always stored locally first. With “Auto-upload”, each upload also asynchronously invokes an external command (PicGo / upgit / picfast CLI / any script) to push the image to a hosting service; failures fall back to local storage without affecting editing.
imageUpload.modeAutoHint: Local storage + async upload, falls back on failure
imageUpload.commandHint: Executable name (on PATH) or absolute path; the image path is appended as the last argument
imageUpload.contractHint: Images stay stored locally and render reliably inside the app; after a successful upload, the hosted URL is used only when exporting or sharing a document.

termDict.title: Entity Dictionary
termDict.helpTip: Declared alias → canonical-name rules: extraction, retrieval and merging all converge on the canonical name; industry term packs can be imported wholesale
termDict.description: Declare canonical-name ↔ alias rules (e.g. wafer ↔ 晶圆). Saving an entry applies immediately: the Entities page, global search, and MCP find the entity by either name; note search expands aliases to the canonical name. An empty dictionary changes nothing.
termDict.saved: Saved and applied — search by canonical name or alias
termDict.descriptionPlaceholder: What is this entity? (optional; takes priority over AI-generated)
termDict.importHint: Paste an industry dictionary JSON or pick a file; entries merge by canonical name
